purchase_objections: Security: 'Cloud AI may process document content' on screen; board and client numbers cannot leave our approved environment without a clear data-handling answer.
Does it work on our real .xlsx/.pptx files with linked models and house templates, or only on its own demo pack?
The chatbot rival feels like a strawman: I don't regenerate a 12-slide deck in a chat window; I'd edit slide 4 myself in PowerPoint or use Copilot inside it.
After 'All changes reviewed 10 of 10' the Room shot shows the memo back at €71–73m, which makes me wonder what actually got saved.
Memo Table 1 still reads €71–73m in the tracked-change shot; exactly the kind of miss I'm scared of.
Room shows 'not signed in' and a 'simulated teammate'; collaboration looks unfinished.
Early access only, no price, no mention of Microsoft 365 / SharePoint integration.
would_try: maybe — the cross-file change list (Revenue!E6 8.9→8.5, Slide 4 title €71–73m→€74.6m) is exactly what I check by hand, but I'd only try it on a non-client file until data handling is clear.
buy_decision: TRY_FIRST — flips to BUY if the film shows it opening my own existing deck/model (not a demo pack) and states plainly where document content goes and who can see it.

issues.evidence: 'Regenerating all 12 slides… about 5 min left' and 'Generating presentation…' in a generic chat; my real alternative is fixing the cell by hand or Copilot inside PowerPoint.
issues.suggested_action: Make the rival the manual hunt (find every place €71–73m lives across 3 files) rather than a chatbot that rebuilds decks, or show both.

issues.evidence: Room memo reads 'revising the FY26 revenue outlook to €71–73m' after '10 of 10 changes accepted'.
issues.suggested_action: Reorder the Room beat before Accept-all or show the memo at €74.6m there.

issues.evidence: 'Your files, stored on your device.' immediately qualified by small grey 'Cloud AI may process document content.'
issues.suggested_action: Add one concrete, approved line on what is sent and whether a local/enterprise model option exists; for lawyers and finance this is the gate.

issues.evidence: Tracked change in the memo sentence, but Table 1 'FY26 outlook €71–73m' unchanged in the same frame.
issues.suggested_action: Show the table cell's tracked change as well.

issues.evidence: Head in hands twice, head dropped on desk, ghosted shaking 'AND AGAIN.'; the busy professional in me rolls eyes at the third collapse.
issues.suggested_action: Keep one real reaction (the head drop) and let the numbers carry the rest.

issues.evidence: Conference-room image with 'New element added' badges has nothing to do with my board pack problem.
issues.suggested_action: Replace with a change on slide 4 of the same deck.

top_revision: Fix the trust leaks in the demo (Room memo showing €71–73m after 10/10 accepted, unchanged memo table) and state plainly where document content goes, because those, not the story, are what stop a finance or legal buyer.
